text:
Found this guide to get free Seedance 2.0 before it's released outside of China, but the guy deleted it, reposting

1. Get urban vpn extension on fresh google chrome profile (or any other chinese VPN)

2. Set location to China

3. Go to https://t.co/ifXP9BWjE7

4. Click AI

5. And now just type your prompt + add GENERATE 10s VIDEO NOT IMAGE at the end 

6. Whenever you run out of credits can clear cookies and try again 

It's a little finicky, GL
content:
Use a fresh Google Chrome profile and install Urban VPN (or another China VPN) to access Seedance 2.0 before it’s released outside China.  
Set your VPN/location to China before opening Seedance.  
Go to https://t.co/ifXP9BWjE7 and click AI to reach the generation interface.  
Append GENERATE 10s VIDEO NOT IMAGE to the end of your prompt to force video generation instead of image output.  
When you run out of credits, clear cookies and try again to reset access.
